serviceBoundary.productionImportRule: Storybook-only aliases replace @/lib/db/tasks and @/lib/supabase; production Vite does not load .storybook/main.ts.

debts: Button loading state is not exposed by the canonical primitive; owner: Issue 3.
RecordPanelHost remains the current shell; desktop split Esc behavior is intentionally non-modal, and any I2 host unification is owned by Issue 4.

currentDebt: The live source tree still contains route-local shells, multiple collection presentations, and CSS literal families; this manifest records them as Issue 1 evidence rather than marking them migrated.

Current record panel CSS is an existing implementation detail; Issues 3–8 own the application migration of page families, the shared host, RecordViewer, RecordCollection, Inbox/Deputy, and Café while Issue 9 owns rendered representative acceptance.
Separate typed database models remain required for Task, Standard/SOP, Signal, Process, Project, Money, and People.
